The whole peffect_gain_level() also uses return-valued Can_rise_up(), get_level(), and rndexp() on cursed/blessed paths; audit and port missing consumed callees and goto_level() wiring before source completion.
Preserve gp.potion_unkn on cursed path and the u.uexp adjustment on blessed path.
